■ Stage Direction
Age: 4–6 years old
Preschooler age, around the time she could hold conversations with adults

Hehe, aren't you a darling? Saying such sweet things.
I know racing keeps you busy, but come listen to us anytime!

That's right! We'll welcome you with arms full of amore!
Be sure to come back for more, dear angeli!

I want the same one as Mama!
Because Mama's sound is so gentle, and I love it!

I remember that moment clearly!
Out of all those instruments, I picked it up without a single hesitation!

I wanted to converse even more deeply with Sounds of Earth.
With that thought in mind, I resolved to take up the violin.

Ah, I must convey this commozione without a moment to spare—
Don't you agree? Come, let us go together!
Mm... this one! The violin!!
—They taught my young self so many wonderful things.

Ah! Trainer was deeply moved as well!
Saying they thoroughly enjoyed the sublime violin performance!

Yeah!
Hey, can I try playing it? Just like Mama!

Giocoso, vivace, grazioso...
Words meant to express the melodia that "plays" within me.

Pattering along right behind us with tiny steps,
clapping after every single performance—

Oh, angeli! So wonderful of you to come!
Thank you for accepting our amore!

Hm? What's the matter?
You have such a solemn look on your face.

Sì. In the past, and forever into the future.
The violin remains my cherished partner.

Indeed, indeed! L'orchestra always
plays such soul-stirring melodia.

Mamma mia!
And here I thought you came knowing all along!

Her very essence is music. Immersing myself in it even more
would surely be one path toward becoming a true partner.

The pleasure was all mine. I truly enjoyed our conversation today.
Grazie, amore!

Amore!
I had no idea you were someone who appreciated a concerto!

Even so, I will continue to applaud with all my might!
Beniiiiissimo!!!!

Fufu, is that so, is that so!
Then how about we practice in secret and give your mama a big surprise?

Playing musica alongside them made my heart dance,
and my young self was completely captivated by the act of weaving notes at will.

Naturally! Everyone's musica is an irreplaceable energia, after all.
I'll be back whenever I need a boost of coraggio!

The orchestra's name had sounded familiar,
and it turned out to be the very one where Sounds of Earth's mother served as concertmaster.

Esattamente!
This orchestra is my second family!
So you see, she really feels like a daughter to the whole orchestra.

Sì!
The violin was the very first instrument I ever touched!
Bravissimo!!

And how to converse with instruments, as well—
They've all been wonderful artisti since back then. It was an invaluable experience.

Trainer, is our Earth doing well?
Please take good care of her, she's practically our daughter, you know.

From then on, I devoted myself to pratica practically every day.
Wherever I went, my violin went with me.

Ever since she was little, Earth's mother would bring her along,
so she spent a lot of time around our orchestra.

Yes. Each time I discovered new words and emotions,
I gave them voice through the violin.

Fufu. What delightful praise!
So, did today's musica meet your fancy?

On my day off, I attended a performance by a renowned orchestra.
I thought immersing myself in music would help me understand Sounds of Earth better.

Fufu, that is the highest compliment. Thank you!
We'll be looking forward to your sessions together as well!

Ciao, Mama! Everyone!
Today's performance shook my very soul once again! Grazie!!

Pulled along by Sounds of Earth, I rushed out of the seating area.
After slipping through the staff entrance with apparent ease, we arrived at—

Even a thunderous standing ovation
would fall short of capturing the commozione residing in my chest!

Afterward, the two of us stopped by a café,
where I listened to Sounds of Earth reminisce about her past.

I came to understand that the bond between Sounds of Earth,
music, and the violin ran far deeper than I had ever imagined.

The vibrations created by the instruments reached straight to the seats.
An overwhelming intensity that resonated not just in the ears, but through the entire body—
At times, my burning passion for racing—

Hey there, little Earth.
Which instrument would you like to play?

With just a single stroke, I could speak volumes.
Far more eloquently than with mere words.

She said the violin is an instrument that can
speak far more eloquently than words. If that's the case—
And at times, the profound emotion felt during a session—

Mama used to play the violin as a lullaby for me.
So when it came to choosing an instrument, there was only ever one choice.
(Clap clap clap clap!!!)
